pull_requests.title: Pull requests
pull_requests.description: Pull requests from this project’s GitHub repository. Asking agents about the code and sending work back for a fix are planned.
pull_requests.refreshAfterSync: Refresh is available when this sync ends.
pull_requests.refreshAfterReset: Refresh is available again after the reset.
pull_requests.syncFailed: Pull requests could not be synced

loadFailed.title: Pull requests could not be read
loadFailed.body: The pull requests stored for this project could not be read: {{reason}}

query.searchPlaceholder: Search title, PR number or branch…
query.syncNote: Sync runs on open, on Refresh and every minute while this screen is open.

sync.troubled: Last synced {{time}} · GitHub is having trouble
sync.neverTroubled: Not synced · GitHub is having trouble

hint.notChecked: The GitHub connection has not been checked yet. Check again to see which account gh is signed in to.
hint.signInUnknown: gh answers, but whether it is signed in could not be read. Check again; sync waits until it is.
hint.programMissing: Install the GitHub CLI or choose its program file in Connections, then check again. Sync waits until gh is found.
hint.unrecognized: The program did not answer as the GitHub CLI. Update gh or choose its program file in Connections, then check again.
hint.couldNotRun: gh could not be started or did not answer in time. Check again, or edit the GitHub connection.

notice.notSynced: Pull requests could not be read
notice.unreachable: Couldn’t reach GitHub. The list may be out of date. Orchester retries every 60 s while this screen is open; Refresh tries now.
notice.unreachableNoList: Couldn’t reach GitHub. Orchester retries every 60 s while this screen is open; Refresh tries now.
notice.serverError: GitHub is having trouble ({{status}}). Try again in a moment: Orchester retries every 60 s while this screen is open, and Refresh tries now.
notice.serverErrorUnknown: GitHub is having trouble and did not finish its answer. Try again in a moment: Orchester retries every 60 s while this screen is open, and Refresh tries now.
notice.noAccess: GitHub found no repository this account can read. Ask the owner for access, or switch accounts in gh, then check again.
notice.unrecognized: gh answered in a format Orchester doesn’t recognise. Update gh, then refresh.
notice.couldNotRun: gh could not be started or did not answer in time. Refresh, or check the connection.
notice.failed: GitHub did not return the list. Refresh tries again; the log has the details.
notice.rateLimited: gh reports no requests left for {{account}}; the limit resets in {{minutes}} min. The list is from {{time}}, and sync resumes on its own after the reset.
notice.rateLimitedNoList: gh reports no requests left for {{account}}; the limit resets in {{minutes}} min. Sync resumes on its own after the reset.
notice.rateLimitedUnknown: gh reports no requests left for {{account}} and did not say when the limit resets. Refresh tries again.
notice.wrongAccount: The list is from {{time}}. Sync and creating pull requests are paused until gh uses {{expected}} again, or until {{project}} expects {{active}}. Orchester never switches gh accounts.
notice.wrongAccountNoList: Sync and creating pull requests are paused until gh uses {{expected}} again, or until {{project}} expects {{active}}. Orchester never switches gh accounts.
notice.missingScope: gh is signed in as {{account}} without the {{scope}} scope, so Orchester can’t read or create pull requests. The list is from {{time}}. Add the scope in a terminal, then check again.
notice.missingScopeNoList: gh is signed in as {{account}} without the {{scope}} scope, so Orchester can’t read or create pull requests. Add the scope in a terminal, then check again.
notice.notSignedInTitle: gh is not signed in to {{host}}
notice.notSignedIn: Run this in a terminal, then check again. Sync waits until gh is signed in.

unavailable.title: Pull requests are unavailable
unavailable.detail: {{project}} isn’t linked to a GitHub repository. Pull requests come from the repository detected in the project folder’s origin remote, read through the GitHub CLI (gh). Tasks and runs keep working locally.

open.title: No open pull requests
open.detail: {{owner}} / {{name}} has no open pull requests on GitHub. New ones appear here after the next sync.

needsReview.title: Nothing needs your review
needsReview.detail: No open pull request in {{owner}} / {{name}} asks for your review. Review requests from GitHub appear here after the next sync.

agentWorking.title: No agent is working on a pull request
agentWorking.detail: No run of this project’s tasks is working on the branch of an open pull request in {{owner}} / {{name}}.

merged.title: No merged pull requests
merged.detail: None of the recently updated closed pull requests of {{owner}} / {{name}} was merged.

closed.title: No closed pull requests
closed.detail: None of the recently updated pull requests of {{owner}} / {{name}} was closed without merging.

noMatches.title: No pull request matches
noMatches.detail: Nothing in this tab matches “{{query}}”. Search finds a title, a number, a branch or a task’s key.

detail.title: Pull request #{{number}}
detail.loadFailed: The pull request could not be read

tabs.planned: Agent feedback, Agent checks and Overview are planned.

detail.rangePlanned: Choosing another revision range is planned.
detail.viewedPlanned: Marking a file viewed is planned.

reading.title: Reading the pull request
reading.detail: Orchester reads the pull request and its diff from GitHub through gh.

notRead.title: The pull request has not been read
notRead.detail: The last sync did not list it and GitHub did not give it. The notice above says why; Refresh tries again.

noChanges.title: No changes
noChanges.detail: The head revision has no changes against the base branch.

tooLarge.title: Too large to show here
tooLarge.detail: This pull request changes {{files}} files, +{{additions}} / −{{deletions}}. Orchester shows diffs of up to 300 files and 20,000 changed lines; review this one in GitHub.
tooLarge.unknown: This pull request changes more than Orchester shows: diffs of up to 300 files and 20,000 changed lines. Review it in GitHub.

unreadable.title: The diff could not be read
unreadable.detail: The diff is not in a format Orchester can read. Open the pull request in GitHub; the log has the details.

notice.mayHaveChanged: The pull request may have changed since it was last read. Refresh tries again.
notice.rateLimited: GitHub accepts requests again in {{minutes}} min; until then this is what was read before.
notice.rateLimitedUnknown: GitHub did not say when the limit resets; until then this is what was read before.
notice.account: Reading waits until gh acts as the account this project expects; Pull requests shows the command to run.
notice.notFound: GitHub has no such pull request
notice.notFoundDetail: It was deleted, or the account gh uses cannot see it.
notice.failed: The pull request could not be read
notice.failedFrom: What shows was read at {{time}}. Refresh tries again; the log has the details.
notice.failedNothing: Refresh tries again; the log has the details.
